clips.title: The story
paras: Magistrate Solomon sends a plea from Lakeshire to Westfall for help against the Blackrock orcs and gnolls. With Stormwind's forces absent, he hopes Gryan Stoutmantle's People's Militia can lend aid.

Blackrock orcs and gnolls besiege Lakeshire, and the Stormwind Army has not arrived in force. Magistrate Solomon knows the town guards and irregulars cannot hold the Redridge Mountains alone. With no royal reserves in sight, he writes a formal plea for help. Word has reached him of a citizen defense group forming west of Elwynn Forest, so he sends his appeal there.

Gryan Stoutmantle is a veteran commander rallying volunteer fighters under the People's Militia banner. Solomon sends his dispatch across the kingdom, hoping Westfall's volunteers can reinforce Lakeshire's borders until the Crown's armies mobilize. But Westfall is fighting its own desperate struggle against the Defias Brotherhood.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Something odd is afoot with the Stormwind Army. They should have been here in force by now. Time is a luxury we don't have, however. I will not stand by and watch the people of Lakeshire give their lives without trying to enlist more help. I've heard word of a people's militia forming in Westfall.
Take this plea to their leader, Gryan Stoutmantle. Perhaps Stoutmantle's men can lend some support here until the King sends reserves.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Hail, warrior. What business do you have with The People's Militia?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Good Messenger, you have served your master well.
